column1: In mobile conversion rate optimization (CRO), what is 'time-to-proof'?
column2: The elapsed time and scroll distance required for a user to see tangible evidence of physical product quality.

column1: Why does moving the portfolio directly beneath the hero section reduce mobile bounce rates?
column2: It immediately validates the hero's value proposition with authentic visual proof before user interest wanes.

column1: How many pixels of vertical scroll distance were saved on mobile by inverting the portfolio and services sections?
column2: Approximately 2,400px (reducing scroll depth from 6–9 thumb swipes down to 1 swipe).

column1: What is the semantic document order of sections in the proof-first architecture?
column2: <header> -> <main> -> #hero -> #portfolio -> #services -> #about -> #contact -> <footer>

column1: Why should the order of <nav> links in the header mirror the exact top-down document order of sections?
column2: To ensure predictable navigation for keyboard users, screen readers, and visual users without cognitive dissonance.

column1: What JavaScript DOM method smoothly scrolls the viewport to a target element in modern browsers?
column2: element.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' })

column1: What is the advantage of using element.scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' }) over window.location.hash = '#portfolio'?
column2: scrollIntoView smooth-scrolls cleanly without triggering a disruptive URL hash change or popstate history entry.

column1: In accessibility, what must happen immediately after a button programmatically filters and scrolls to another section?
column2: Focus must be programmatically transferred to the active UI control (e.g., activeTab.focus()) so keyboard users maintain focus context.

column1: Why are proof pills in the hero section modeled as <button> elements rather than anchor <a> tags?
column2: They perform an immediate in-page JavaScript modal dialog action (openModal) rather than navigating to a new URL.

column1: What CSS property enables glassmorphic transparency and background blurring on modern UI pills?
column2: backdrop-filter: blur(Npx) (with -webkit-backdrop-filter for WebKit compatibility) and a semi-transparent background color.

column1: What is the purpose of the proof-pill-dot pseudo-indicator element inside a proof pill?
column2: To provide an immediate visual cue resembling an active live proof badge or status indicator.

column1: What is the minimum recommended touch target dimension under WCAG 2.1 AA and Apple HIG?
column2: 44 × 44 pixels (or 48 × 48 pixels under Google Material Guidelines).

column1: What does the CSS property touch-action: manipulation do on interactive buttons?
column2: It disables double-tap to zoom on mobile browsers, eliminating the default 300ms tap delay.

column1: How does the jump-to-category event delegation action in app.js work?
column2: It reads dataset.category from the clicked button, invokes filterPortfolio(category), smooth-scrolls to #portfolio, and focuses the matching filter tab.

column1: Why is roving tabindex used on tablist buttons (tabindex="0" for active, tabindex="-1" for inactive)?
column2: It allows the Tab key to enter/exit the tablist as a single stop, while arrow keys navigate between individual tabs.

column1: What does aria-label="Featured Client Proofs" communicate on the hero proof strip container?
column2: It provides an accessible name for screen reader landmark and region navigation, identifying the collection of proof shortcuts.

column1: How does in-place DOM hydration for modal case studies prevent memory leaks?
column2: It re-populates existing persistent DOM nodes rather than repeatedly creating and discarding DOM subtrees.

column1: What happens if a user clicks a service jump button for a category that does not exist?
column2: VALID_PORTFOLIO_CATEGORIES validates the input and gracefully falls back to 'all', preventing runtime crashes.

column1: Why does scroll-margin-top: 80px prevent sticky header occlusion during anchor jumps?
column2: It reserves an 80px scroll margin above the section box, ensuring sticky header bars do not overlap section headings.

column1: What is the primary architectural purpose of the Core Services section when placed after the Portfolio?
column2: To detail technical capabilities and custom production specifications for the deliverables the visitor just observed in the portfolio.

column1: How does centralized click event delegation improve performance when adding numerous proof pills and service buttons?
column2: A single root listener on document intercepts all bubbling events via event.target.closest('[data-action]'), avoiding individual listener memory allocations.

column1: Why should decorative icons and status dots have aria-hidden="true"?
column2: To prevent screen readers from announcing redundant or non-semantic character codes to assistive technology users.
